ea8ef0d8cd3314b9.description: Description Dimensional inspection of castings & forgings against customer specifications and drawings in various stages of casting processes, to ensure the product dimensions meet customer requirements. Dimensional Inspection Carry out dimensional inspection of castings as per drawings & specifications. Measure and accept as per ISO 8062 standard, or as per customer requirement or drawing. Carry out visual inspection of castings and forgings on sample castings. Conduct bulk casting / forgings audit inspection related to dimensional inspection. Ensure casting marking and lettering as per customer drawings and specifications. Equipment & Calibration Maintain measuring and test equipment in the area with calibration status. Non-Conformance & Corrective Action Coordinate with concerned departments for corrective action in case of dimensional deviation on castings. Follow up on casting dimensional correction against the dimensional report if any non-conformity is found. Monitor dimensional related NCR effectiveness. Documentation Maintain dimension reports and relevant documents related to dimensional inspection. Standards Development Develop / assist QC Engineer to develop dimensional inspection standards. Requirements Education ITI / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or similar qualification (preferred). Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in dimensional inspection. Experience in the steel casting / forging industry is essential. Experience in CMM inspection and programming is preferred. Certifications NDE certification ASNT Level II in Visual Inspection is essential. NDE certification ASNT Level II in MT / PT inspection is preferred. Technical Skills Proficiency in operating inspection equipment and understanding quality standards. Ability to interpret engineering drawings and Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T). Ability to interpret ISO, ASME, and ASTM standards related to dimensional and visual inspection. Knowledge of moulding and core assembly is essential.

ea742893088ea91a.description: Job description Company Description John Crane, a business of Smiths Group, is a global leader in mission-critical flow control solutions for energy and process industries that enable efficient and sustainable operations. Our products include mechanical seals and systems, couplings, filtration systems, and predictive digital monitoring technologies. We have a global network of more than 200 sites in over 50 countries and employ more than 6,000 people worldwide. We partner with our customers to help them keep their operations safe, reduce downtime, improve efficiency, and meet the latest environmental standards. John Crane is part of Smiths Group. For over 170 years, Smiths has been pioneering progress by engineering for a better future. We serve millions of people every year, helping to create a safer, more efficient, productive, and better-connected world across four global markets: energy, security & defence, space & aerospace, and general industrial. Listed on the London Stock Exchange, Smiths employs approximately 16,000 colleagues in over 50 countries. Job Description Job Purpose: Lead and coordinate dedicated project teams in the delivery of projects, including sales, engineering, procurement, quality, Projects/EPC KAMs, Customers/OEMs, and others. Perform project risk evaluation throughout the entire project lifetime; identify issues jeopardizing a successful project completion at an early stage and initiate corrective actions. Coordinate the resolution of any technical or commercial conflicts which may arise at any stage. Act as John Crane's single point of contact to support the customer for post-order activity through to project delivery. Coordinate any post-delivery issue resolution. Maintain communication channels with the client. Responsibilities: Fulfilment of customer contracts (deadlines, costs, objectives) and monitor project budgets closely. Creating and maintaining detailed execution schedules for each of the major projects that are your portfolio. Agreeing communication channels with the customer in relation to the different Project aspects. Managing timely and effective communication with the regional Stakeholders to ensure effective coordination. Regularly communicate with the involved parties and keep constant and updated communication with their various senior-level project management. Attending clarification/kick-off meetings and preparing and distributing relevant activity reports. Work with global and local procurement to ensure that any pre-procurement of long lead items is performed, inventory is maintained and managed, suppliers are performing to expectations, etc. In conjunction with manufacturing operations, ensure the project is completed per the agreed customer schedule and budget. Develop and execute solutions when issues arise that might jeopardize either of these objectives. Record project milestones, maintain records of project correspondence, and produce project close-out summaries, including cost analysis. Support on Coordinating customer change requests to ensure optimal solutions for successful project delivery. Lead frequent team calls to support project execution. Provide monthly reports on project status. Manage quality incidents through eQMS and work closely with assigned incident managers to close the incidents in time and ensure RCA/8Ds are available where applicable. Support process streamlining activities, ISO IQMs compliance, and support SES initiatives. Other project delivery initiative tasks as assigned. Qualifications Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Degree educated in a technical discipline. Electrical, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering preferred. Minimum 10 years experience in Project management, preferably in Oil and Gas / Petrochemical projects business. Must be able to read, interpret, and explain complex project specifications. Ability to achieve the agreed goals & objectives by constantly focusing on a set of priorities. Excellent communication, negotiation & presentation skills, both verbal and written. Proper understanding of basic finance. Strong facilitation skills and experience in operating in a matrix environment and adept at swiftly reaching solutions and building consensus under tight deadlines. A PMI Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or a comparable credential is preferred, showcasing a solid foundation in project management methodologies and practices. Experience and knowledge in process improvement methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma are preferred, highlighting a commitment to efficiency and continuous project optimization. Good knowledge of Microsoft suite of products, including MS Project. Preferred experience with Project Lifecycle Management tools (e.g., Teamcenter). Strong level of cultural awareness and capability to adapt behavior accordingly. Fluent in English. Travel up to 15%. Planning and Decision Making: Ability to make quick decisions regarding complex project issues, reducing risk to John Crane and the customer. Develop specific project plans to ensure successful delivery. Empower project team members to make quick decisions to keep projects on track. Impact and Scope: Critical project delivery role influencing the success of strategic, global projects. Working with all regions, internal and external customers. Additional Information With colleagues stretching across the globe, we are proud of our diversity. To foster inclusivity, we run employee resource groups (ERGs) to provide a safe space for employees to connect and support each other. Our cross-business ERGs include Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Women@Work Network, and Neurodiversity. Across our company, we recognize excellence, culminating in the Smiths Excellence Awards, our annual celebration of the most extraordinary activities, people, and projects that best showcase our strengths and help drive our business forward. We announce these on our annual Smiths Day, a global celebration of Smiths around our network. Join us for a great career with competitive compensation and benefits, while helping engineer a better future. We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity. At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Group, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing. Avoid fraudulent requests by applying jobs directly through our career’s website (Careers - Smiths Group plc) Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

ea31f764d0a77278.description: About Red Sea Sports & Entertainment Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE), a subsidiary of Red Sea Global (RSG), is dedicated to providing land and marine experiences at The Red Sea destination. RSSE manages and operates various sports and recreational activities, including water sports (Galaxea), adventure sports (Akun), and general recreation (WAMA). The organization plays a central role in the partnership between Red Sea Global and the Saudi Olympic & Paralympic Committee, aiming to create more inclusive and accessible sports and recreation experiences. RSSE is committed to people and planet, with programs contributing to Vision 2030 and regenerative tourism. Role Overview Red Sea Global is seeking a Manager - Finance to oversee the day-to-day financial operations, reporting, and budget control for Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE) across all its brands and activities. This full-time role operates under the direction of the Cluster Manager – Finance and is responsible for ensuring accurate transaction recording and control implementation, in line with IFRS, company policies, and the Delegation of Authority (DoA). The Manager - Finance will also provide timely financial information to management to support decision-making. Key Responsibilities Manage RSSE's daily finance operations, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), cash, and bank reconciliations. Execute month-end and year-end close processes in SAP, covering accruals, Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt (GR/IR), vendor advances, and unbilled revenue, and submit closing files for review. Prepare monthly and quarterly management reports and variance analysis for RSSE and its individual brands. Collaborate with brand and operations teams to prepare the annual budget and forecasts, submitting them for review and approval. Monitor OPEX and CAPEX against approved budgets, escalating any overruns or unbudgeted requests. Review Purchase Requisitions (PRs), invoices, and payments against approved Purchase Orders (POs), Work Completion Certificates (WCCs), and the DoA prior to approval. Ensure Finance reviews pricing, packages, and commercial agreements, and that they are approved under the DoA. Prepare intercompany recharges and reconciliations with RSG entities and partners, and follow up on collections. Ensure compliance with IFRS, VAT/ZATCA, and internal control requirements. Support internal and external audits, and follow up until audit findings are closed. Prepare financial analysis, Return on Investment (ROI) assessments, and dashboards to support management decisions. Support CAPEX tracking and maintain an accurate fixed asset register. Supervise and develop the RSSE finance team, including Specialists and Senior Specialists. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. 8 years of experience in finance, with at least 2 years in a managerial role. Experience in hospitality, tourism, or entertainment is preferred. CPA, CMA, or SOCPA certification is preferred. Strong SAP experience (FI/CO) is required. Ariba experience is preferred. Work Type This is a full-time position within Red Sea Global.

eadd4909e73c8de8.description: نحن نبحث عن نادل متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا المتميز لتقديم تجربة طعام استثنائية لعملائنا. ستشمل مسؤولياتك استقبال الضيوف، أخذ الطلبات بدقة، وتقديم الأطباق والمشروبات بكفاءة واحترافية. إذا كنت تتمتع بشخصية ودودة، ومهارات تواصل ممتازة، وشغف بخدمة العملاء، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: * استقبال العملاء بابتسامة وترحيب حار. * تقديم قوائم الطعام وشرح الأطباق والمشروبات الخاصة. * أخذ طلبات العملاء بدقة وتسجيلها في النظام. * تقديم الأطباق والمشروبات للعملاء في الوقت المناسب. * التأكد من رضا العملاء وتلبية احتياجاتهم. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل.

ea54aad77054a980.description: مطلوب مساعد إداري لرئيس تنفيذي في شركة تسويق لمساعدة الرئيس التنفيذي في تنفيذ مهامة المتنوعة. المهام والمسؤليات: تنظيم جدول ومواعيد الرئيس التنفيذي. متابعة المهام والمشاريع والتأكد من إنجازها في الوقت المحدد. التنسيق والتواصل مع العملاء والموظفين. تنفيذ بعض المهام التشغيلية في مجال التسويق والمبيعات. إعداد تقارير وملفات المتابعة. التعامل مع المهام المتنوعة والعاجلة. دعم الرئيس التنفيذي في الأعمال اليومية ومتابعة ما يتم تكليفه به حتى الإنجاز. المتطلبات: خبرة سابقة في أي مجال. أن يكون المتقدم شغوف ولديه حماس عالي. القدرة على التنظيم ومنضبط في المواعيد. احترافي ولديه مهارات التواصل. القدرة على تنفيذ المهام وليس فقط المتابعة. إجادة العمل على اللابتوب وتطبيقات التنظيم. طبيعة العمل: حضوري من مقر الشركة في حي الياسمين. دوام كامل أو جزئي. بيئة عمل إبداعية ومميزة.

ea34aac749d0db48.description: About Lenovo Lenovo is a global technology company with US$83 billion in revenue, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500. The company serves millions of customers daily across 180 markets, focusing on delivering smarter technology. Lenovo's portfolio includes AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices, infrastructure, software, solutions, and services, building on its position as a leading PC company. Role Overview This full-time DT Business Process Design Associate Specialist position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Customer Fulfillment DT (Digital Transformation) team under the GSC ISG DT function. The role supports Local Customer Fulfillment DT and End-to-End GEO Supply Chain execution DT. This opportunity provides hands-on experience in customer fulfillment processes, end-to-end supply chain execution, digital solution deployment, and AI-enabled business process improvement within a GEO operating environment. Candidates should have 0-1 years of experience. Position Summary The DT Business Process Design Associate Specialist will act as a Digital Transformation Partner for local Customer Fulfillment and GEO Supply Chain Operations teams. The role focuses on supporting order fulfillment, AI-enabled process improvement, operational visibility, exception management, and digital solution adoption across end-to-end GEO supply chain operations. This position involves collaboration with local Customer Fulfillment leaders, planning, order management, logistics, sales operations, service teams, and global DT teams to enhance customer delivery performance, process efficiency, and business value realization. Key Responsibilities Serve as a Digital Transformation partner for local Customer Fulfillment operations and GEO supply chain execution. Support order fulfillment performance, backlog management, delivery visibility, exception resolution, system adoption, and operational problem-solving. Support end-to-end process improvement initiatives across demand, order, allocation, supply commit, logistics, delivery, and customer fulfillment functions. Analyze local business processes to identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and cross-functional alignment. Support deployment and enhancement of customer fulfillment and supply chain solutions, including SAP, order management tools, planning platforms, logistics visibility tools, workflow automation, analytics dashboards, and AI-enabled applications. Participate in requirements gathering, process design, testing, training, user support, change management, and hypercare activities. Partner with business users to maximize system adoption, process compliance, and business value realization. Analyze fulfillment, order, inventory, logistics, and service data to identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities. Translate business requirements into data-driven insights, dashboards, recommendations, and AI-enabled use cases. Support AI and automation initiatives such as intelligent exception detection, order prioritization, delivery risk prediction, touchless process enablement, and decision support. Support initiatives that improve customer delivery experience, service level performance, order cycle time, and supply chain responsiveness. Participate in proof-of-concept and pilot projects for AI, automation, advanced analytics, and digital workflow innovation in Customer Fulfillment. Benefits and Development Opportunities Access to an international team with a focus on gender diversity. Employee Assistance Program offering psychological, legal, and financial consultancy. Opportunity to join a company that prioritizes sustainable solutions, including CO2 Offset, Asset Recovery Services, and the Lenovo Certified Refurbished portfolio. Access to training for personal development through an internal E-learning Development Platform. Participation in a mentorship program.

eaef93e0df5b6335.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Commercial & Partnerships Development for the Healthcare Sector. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, is responsible for leading the development and structuring of commercial and partnership arrangements that support QHC’s business development priorities. The position reports to the Executive — Business Development and requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Purpose and Context The Director will develop commercial and partnership requirements, lead partner engagement and sourcing, and create partnership propositions, commercial models, and contracting requirements for priority opportunities. This is a foundational role, crucial for early market engagement, structured evaluation, and securing commercial and partnership opportunities. The role involves collaboration across the leadership team, the Qiddiya ecosystem, and external stakeholders to build a partnership pipeline, structure agreements, govern partner obligations, and coordinate brand and launch activities for QHC. Key Responsibilities Develop partner requirements and shape partnership and commercial priorities aligned with QHC's clinical, operational, and growth objectives. Build and manage a prioritized pipeline of partnership and commercial opportunities across sports, healthcare, payer, technology, and ecosystem partners. Identify and evaluate new commercial and partnership models, developing recommendations for leadership review. Lead partner identification, engagement, and sourcing, representing QHC to external partners and stakeholders. Originate and progress priority partnership opportunities, including engagement, evaluation, negotiation preparation, and follow-up through to agreement. Develop and structure commercial arrangements, models, and contracting requirements, ensuring deals are commercially sound and operationally deliverable. Coordinate contracting, obligations, and commercial structuring in partnership with legal, finance, and relevant functions. Develop commercial terms and recommendations that protect QHC’s interests and align with service and partnership requirements. Track partner obligations and deliverables, ensuring commitments are met by both parties. Coordinate partner governance, performance monitoring, issue resolution, and escalation for active partnerships. Maintain the partner and contract register and report on partnership performance. Develop and manage commercial and partnership relationships across the Qiddiya ecosystem and with relevant external partners. Coordinate with QIC and ecosystem partners to leverage shared opportunities and avoid duplication. Act as a key relationship point for priority commercial and partnership stakeholders. Coordinate brand, awareness, and launch communications in partnership with marketing and communications, considering QHC's reputational exposure. Ensure partnership and commercial activity aligns with and supports QHC's brand and market positioning. Support go-to-market and launch milestones during the startup phase. Contribute to QHC's revenue growth, service monetization, and competitive positioning through partnerships and commercial arrangements. Provide commercial input to business cases, pricing, and new service-line development. Track and report commercial and partnership KPIs to leadership. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 8+ years of relevant experience is required for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Qiddiya Investment Company. The role involves working closely with internal leadership teams, the broader Qiddiya ecosystem, and external stakeholders to achieve strategic partnership and commercial goals.

eaf7a9d98b308a95.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الجميح للسيارات عن سكرتير تنفيذي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم الإداري والتنظيمي للمدير/الرئيس، مما يضمن سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وفعالية. يتطلب الدور تنظيم المواعيد، إعداد المذكرات، إجراء المراسلات، وحضور الاجتماعات لتحرير المحاضر، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنظيم مواعيد المدير/الرئيس وتذكيره بها بشكل مستمر. التعامل مع الاستفسارات الواردة والرد عليها، بالإضافة إلى إيصال البريد والمراسلات للمدير/الرئيس. إعداد المذكرات الدورية وتلك المتعلقة بعمل الوحدات التنظيمية الداخلية. إجراء المراسلات الاعتيادية مع الجهات الخارجية، والتأكد من توقيعها من المدير/الرئيس، ثم توزيعها. حضور الاجتماعات وتسجيل محاضرها وتحريرها بدقة. حفظ الوثائق والملفات المتعلقة بأعمال المدير/الرئيس بطريقة منظمة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال السكرتارية التنفيذية أو دور إداري مشابه. القدرة على تنظيم الوقت وإدارة المهام المتعددة بفعالية. مهارات تواصل كتابية وشفوية ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة الجميح للسيارات في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في المكتب وتقديم الدعم المباشر للإدارة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

ea1b72dcb968ded3.description: About John Crane and the Role John Crane is seeking a Project Coordinator - KSA to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves supporting project execution and controls within the organization. The Project Coordinator will contribute to ensuring the effective management of projects from initiation to close-out. Key Responsibilities Assist Programme Managers and Project Engineers in the effective execution of project controls across all project phases, including initiating, planning, monitoring & controlling, internal communication, and close-out. Prepare weekly and monthly reports, update schedules, coordinate project progress, prepare manpower histograms, create and update S-Curves, prepare time impact analyses, and manage cash flow under the guidance of the Programme Coordinator and Programme Planner. Support Programme Managers and Project Engineers with financial forecasting and coordinate any discrepancies that may affect forecasting accuracy. Ensure project health check issues are highlighted quickly and effectively, providing feedback on issues, risks, and benefits. Prepare documentation reflecting issues, risks, and opportunities under the guidance of the Programme Coordinator and Programme Planner. Ensure timely, accurate, and standardized project reporting for assigned projects at all levels. Assist the Programme Planner by ensuring Commercial Sheets for assigned projects are updated as per requirements and report any anomalies impacting internal reporting. Maintain a document management and version control system for all project documents, in accordance with company standards. Attend key project working meetings, including daily coordination meetings, and prepare and circulate meeting minutes promptly. Organize and coordinate internal program audits and support follow-up activities. Assemble and structure all project-related documentation for archiving and uploading to SharePoint via the PMO. Ensure lessons learned are continuously and timely captured by projects and programs and shared among teams for improvement. Support the Programme Planner in preparing weekly financial revenue, billing, and cash flow reports for market reviews. Support Programme Managers and Project Engineers in compiling all supporting documents and reports for revenue recognition. Prepare payment applications based on project progress, as arranged with the PM and PMO Manager, and maintain a monitoring log or tracker. Prepare Purchase Requests (PR) in SAP as requested by the PM and PMO Manager. Compliance and Ethics The Project Coordinator is responsible for ensuring that the Smiths Code of Corporate Responsibility and Business Ethics is upheld in all activities. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in project coordination or a similar role. Demonstrated ability to assist in the execution of project controls across various project phases. Proficiency in preparing various project reports, schedules, and financial forecasts. Experience with document management, version control systems, and SAP is preferred. Work Environment and Culture John Crane fosters an inclusive environment with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. The company values diverse perspectives and backgrounds, ensuring equal consideration for employment regardless of various protected characteristics. Smiths Detection, part of Smiths Group, is a global leader in security and detection solutions, contributing to making the world a safer place through its technology in aviation, ports and borders, defense, and urban security. Application Information Applicants should apply directly through the company's careers website to avoid fraudulent requests. Smiths Detection and its recruitment partners will never request payment for participation in the hiring process.

ea4e5d363afe7bf8.description: About the Role Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG) is seeking a Laser Technician to support laser procedures. This full-time role involves providing assistance and administrative tasks, utilizing comprehensive laser skills to ensure patient satisfaction. The position requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Adhere to all HMG policies, including obtaining an invoice before any procedure. Refer new patients to a Dermatologist for explanation and consent. Refer patients to a Dermatologist for any problems encountered during or after treatment. Communicate with patients in a polite, accurate, and timely manner, respecting their decisions. Prepare patients before and after treatment, ensuring their privacy. Provide health instructions regarding pre- and post-treatment care. Monitor and report any machine or accessory damages or problems to the CN, HN, and Bio-Medical engineers. Maintain confidentiality of all patient treatments and records. Book clients/patients for their next appointments. Manage the aftercare of all used items. Complete all documentation accurately and clearly once treatment is done, including parameters used, for reference. Orient and assist new staff members within the unit, identifying limitations and helping develop their skills. Provide patient and family education as needed. Participate in person-centered care initiatives undertaken by HMG. Enrich patient experience with compassion, respect, and dignity. Perform other applicable tasks and duties assigned within the scope of work. Qualifications and Requirements Education/Professional Qualification: Diploma, preferably a Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or Laser Technology, or an equivalent qualification. Professional Licensing/Certification/Training: Valid Saudi Council Registration is required. Experience: 2-5 years of relevant experience. Work Type This is a full-time position within Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib (HMG). Patient Care Focus The role emphasizes a commitment to patient satisfaction and adherence to established healthcare protocols, ensuring a high standard of care and communication throughout the treatment process. Application Information Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

ea56645a71ad582f.description: About the Role Al Rushaid Group is seeking a Work Permit Receiver (WPR) to join their team in Al Khobar. This full-time position is critical for ensuring compliance with safety protocols and operational procedures within oil and gas construction projects. Key Responsibilities Coordinating field activities under permit conditions to ensure safe execution of work. Interpreting construction drawings and method statements to understand project requirements and safety implications. Ensuring strict adherence to the Saudi Aramco Permit to Work (PTW) system. Qualifications and Experience A Diploma or Technical qualification is preferred. Must possess a valid Saudi Aramco WPR certification. A minimum of 3 years of experience in oil & gas construction projects is required. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of overall experience. Required Skills Thorough knowledge of the Saudi Aramco Permit to Work (PTW) system. Demonstrated experience in coordinating field activities under various permit conditions. Ability to accurately interpret construction drawings and method statements. Good communication skills in English are essential for effective coordination and reporting. Work Environment This role is based in Al Khobar and is a full-time position within the Al Rushaid Group. The Work Permit Receiver will operate within dynamic oil and gas construction project environments. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

ea718b0b94bf9fd2.description: About the Role Teleflex is seeking a Regional Sales Manager for MENA to operate as an external contractor, reporting to the Senior Regional Sales Manager, Indirect Business. This contract role focuses on growing the Anesthesia & Respiratory Care business across the MENA region, including Saudi Arabia, by developing existing customer and distributor relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and expanding into new markets. The initial contract period is six months, with potential extensions based on business needs and mutual written agreement. Key Responsibilities Develop and grow the existing Anesthesia & Respiratory Care business in alignment with the business unit strategy and agreed sales objectives for each distributor. Strengthen relationships with existing distributors and customers to enhance market penetration and drive sustainable growth. Identify, assess, and develop new markets, customer segments, and business opportunities across the MENA region. Develop and implement regional growth plans in collaboration with the Senior Regional Sales Manager and the EMEA business unit. Support distributors with commercial activities and relevant sales and marketing programs, ensuring understanding of the clinical and commercial value of focus products. Identify and develop new distributors where necessary, coordinating with relevant internal stakeholders. Collaborate with Clinical & Medical Affairs, Compliance, and Legal in accordance with Teleflex policies and guidelines. Coordinate with distributors and internal teams to support timely product registration in target markets. Gather and share market intelligence, including market trends, pricing, competitor activities, and customer needs. Provide regular sales performance updates, forecasts, and business development reports, contributing to continuous improvement of commercial processes. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in sales or business development within the medical device or healthcare industry, specifically with Anesthesia & Respiratory Care products. Work Environment This is a home-office based position. The role requires regular travel to distributors, customers, meetings, training sessions, and industry events across the MENA region. Contract Details This is an external contractor assignment for an initial period of six months. Any extension will be subject to business needs and mutual written agreement. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

ea83eff07e89e379.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحلول الميسرة لتقنية المعلومات عن أخصائي إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم الرئيس المباشر في تحديد الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم، وتنفيذ مجموعة متنوعة من المهام الإدارية، وتقديم الدعم لزملاء العمل، وإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. الغرض من الوظيفة يقوم الأخصائي الإداري بتقديم الدعم الإداري والتشغيلي لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية داخل الفرع أو الإدارة. يشمل ذلك المساهمة في تحقيق الأهداف، ونقل المعرفة، وتنفيذ العمليات الإدارية المتنوعة، ومتابعة الإجراءات الحكومية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة الرئيس المباشر في وضع الأهداف الرئيسية للإدارة أو القسم، واقتراح وتطبيق الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيقها. تقديم الدعم والمساندة لزملاء العمل الأقل خبرة في الفرع أو الإدارة، والتأكد من نقل الخبرات والمعارف اللازمة لتطويرهم وتحسين مستوى أدائهم. تنفيذ مختلف العمليات الإدارية والإجرائية حسب حاجة العمل لتغطية احتياجات الفرع أو الإدارة. تنفيذ العمليات والمشروعات والمبادرات المتخصصة، وتوظيف المعارف والخبرات الفنية لضمان تحقيق أفضل النتائج. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، والعمل على حفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. متابعة تجديد المعاملات الحكومية وغيرها من الإجراءات اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء وتنفيذ مجموعة من المهام الإدارية المختلفة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل الأخصائي الإداري في مدينة الرياض ضمن فريق شركة الحلول الميسرة لتقنية المعلومات، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التعاون وتقديم الدعم المستمر. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وسيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة بعد المقابلة.

ead19f208da3d378.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اهتمامات لامعه عن مشرف نظافة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة في مجال شركات التنظيف، مع التركيز على إدارة فرق العمل وتنظيم مهام التنظيف للمنازل والمكاتب. سيكون المرشح مسؤولاً عن ضمان تقديم خدمات نظافة عالية الجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة ومتابعة فرق عمل النظافة لضمان الأداء الفعال. تنظيم وتوزيع مهام التنظيف للمنازل والمكاتب بشكل يومي. التأكد من الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في جميع عمليات التنظيف. حل أي مشكلات قد تواجه فرق العمل أو العملاء بخصوص خدمات النظافة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة سابقة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الإشراف على النظافة ضمن شركات التنظيف. إلمام تام بإدارة فرق العمل وتوزيع المهام بكفاءة. القدرة على تنظيم جداول العمل ومتابعة سير المهام. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في تقديم خدمات النظافة. ستتاح للمشرف فرصة للعمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع فرق العمل والعملاء. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

ead1e165e43cfe12.description: About the Internship Tabby is offering a DataOps Internship for early-career engineers. This is an engineering role with real responsibilities, not a course or shadowing program. Interns will join the Data Platform team, working on production infrastructure under senior review, and are expected to meet engineering standards from day one. The Data Platform Team The Data Platform team manages the infrastructure that supports AI, ML, and data workloads at Tabby. This includes compute, orchestration, deployment, observability, and cost control across cloud environments. The work combines aspects of classic DevOps with machine learning operations, ensuring that clusters, pipelines, and monitoring support both service uptime and model training, serving, and measurement. Key Responsibilities Work with cloud infrastructure, primarily GCP, and bare-metal fleets hosting data, ML, and AI workloads. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for services and models. Run and troubleshoot containerized workloads on Kubernetes. Set up and improve monitoring, alerting, and logging systems, and respond to their outputs. Automate repetitive operational tasks using Python or Bash. Support model training and inference workloads, including environments, resources, deployment, and cost management. Investigate incidents in infrastructure and pipelines to identify root causes. Improve the reliability and cost efficiency of the platform. Ensure compliance with SAMA regulatory requirements, particularly regarding data residency and access in Saudi fintech. Qualifications and Requirements 0-1 years of experience. Comfortable working in Linux and cloud environments. Experience using AI tools in practical applications. Internship Details This is a paid, six-month internship scheduled to start in autumn 2026. Interns will be fully integrated into an engineering team. Tabby operates with a distributed engineering team across multiple countries. While not guaranteed, the intent is for successful interns to transition into a junior role on the platform team following the internship, dependent on performance.

ea097adefce50cab.description: About CodeNinja CodeNinja is a global software and AI infrastructure company delivering full-stack technology solutions across AI, software engineering, data, and digital transformation. With operations across Saudi Arabia and global technology hubs , CodeNinja works with organizations across multiple industries to deliver technology solutions that support business transformation and innovation. Our teams work across areas including AI, software engineering, data and analytics, cloud, enterprise technology, and digital transformation . CodeNinja is looking for a Senior Denodo Data Virtualization Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Denodo Data Virtualization, banking data modeling, and Enterprise Data Management (EDM) . About the Role In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize data virtualization solutions that provide secure, governed, and high-performance access to data across multiple enterprise and banking data sources. The ideal candidate will have practical experience working with Denodo, banking data models, EDW, BI, Big Data/Data Lakes, BusinessObjects BI, and Informatica Data Management technologies . Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain Denodo data virtualization layers for enterprise and banking environments. Develop reusable Base Views, Derived Views, Associations, Data Services, Cached Views, and Semantic/Business Views . Integrate and virtualize data from multiple sources, including EDWs, relational databases, data lakes, banking applications, operational systems, and APIs. Apply banking data modeling principles to build efficient and business-oriented virtual data models. Translate business and technical requirements into scalable data virtualization solutions.
